description: Land Acquisition - Ihalagama, Udubaddawa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under the Land Acquisition Act regarding the government's intention to acquire specific lands and servitudes for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of the lands to be acquired (including lot numbers, land names, claimants, and exact measurements), specifies the location (village, division, district), and provides procedures for interested parties to claim compensation. This falls squarely under land and property-related matters, specifically land acquisition, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
